entries.zh: 糯：糯米，黏性之稻米；西注“极好之米”。
entries.en: glutinous rice; “very good rice” (17th-c. Spanish gloss).

entries.zh: 糯米：黏性糯米；西注“一种极白的稻米”。
entries.en: glutinous rice; a kind of rice, very white.

entries.zh: 谷：稻谷、谷实（带壳之谷粒）；西注“米之谷实”。
entries.en: grain, unhusked rice (“rice as its fruit/grain”).

entries.zh: 把：一把、一束（量词；一把稻禾）；西注“米一束”。
entries.en: a handful, a sheaf (“rice in a bundle”, Sp. manojo).

entries.zh: 粽：粽子，叶裹米入水煮成的食品；西注（残损）大意“米以水煮而成”。
entries.en: zongzi, glutinous-rice dumpling boiled in wrapped leaves; Spanish gloss partly illegible (rice boiled in water).

entries.zh: 秫：黏谷、糯性谷物；西注“珍贵的黏米”。
entries.en: glutinous grain, sticky rice (“precious, sticky rice”).

entries.zh: 米秫：酿米酒所用的上好秫米；西注“可酿酒之好米”。
entries.en: glutinous rice for making wine (“very good rice of which wine is made”).

entries.zh: 秫谷：糯谷、秫之谷粒；西注“珍贵的黑米”。
entries.en: glutinous grain (“precious black rice”).

entries.zh: 酿：酿造、发酵（酿酒之米发涨成酒）；西注“米发涨以成酒”。
entries.en: to brew, ferment (“rice swelling/fermenting for wine”).

entries.zh: 酿酒：酿酒、造酒。
entries.en: to brew wine, make liquor.

entries.zh: 谷实〔字有疑：有谷／秫谷／白谷〕；西文词头残损，义约指稻谷。
entries.en: rice grain (character doubtful; Spanish headword garbled).
entries.notes: H栏原注疑字（有/秫/白），L栏“arroz hans, in util”残损，据M栏ba-tsenn与R栏拟为谷实义，未能确指。

entries.zh: 早仔米：早稻米、早熟之米；西注“早稻”。
entries.en: early rice, rice of the early harvest (“arroz temprano”).

entries.zh: 储蓄：储存、积蓄（储藏米谷）；西文词头残损。
entries.en: to store up, save; grain kept in store (Spanish headword garbled).
entries.notes: L栏“arroz de hoctra”无法通读，H/M/R三栏互证为储蓄（储藏）义，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 穗米（或“圆米”）：谷穗之米；西注“红米”（colorado），各栏字义未能全合。
entries.en: ear-grain rice / possibly round-grain rice; Spanish gloss “arroz colorado” (red rice) does not fully match.
entries.notes: R栏iuèn-mǐ与“穗(suì)米”对音不合、或为“圆米”，且L注“红米”与H字义有出入，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 皱：起皱、皱褶；西注“皱（arrugar）”。
entries.en: to wrinkle, be wrinkled (“arrugar”).

entries.zh: 皱绠〔字有疑：绠／网〕：衣物起皱、皱成网状褶纹；西注“如衣裳起皱”。
entries.en: wrinkled (of cloth), wrinkles forming a mesh/net pattern.
entries.notes: H栏疑字（绠/网），据L栏“ut vestidos”与M/R栏定为衣物皱褶义。

entries.zh: 皱皮：皮肤起皱、皱皮；西注“皱如皮肤”。
entries.en: wrinkled skin (“wrinkled, as the skin”).

entries.zh: 绵烂：绵软烂糊、煮烂失形（绵绵烂烂）；西注“皱缩绵烂”（arrugada）。
entries.en: soft and mushy, overcooked/limp; Spanish gloss “shriveled” (arrugada).

entries.zh: 眉头相结：皱眉、眉头紧皱；西注（残）起于“皱……”。
entries.en: to knit one’s brows, frown (“brows knotted together”).

entries.zh: 弛〔字有疑：弛／地〕：松弛、废弛；西注“毁坏、毁灭”（ruinar/destruir）。
entries.en: to slacken, fall into ruin; “to ruin, destroy” (character doubtful).
entries.notes: H栏疑字（弛/地）且M/R两栏声调号污损（T99），据L栏ruinar/destruir定毁坏义。

entries.zh: 破：破、破损；完结、完了（西注 acabar）。
entries.en: to break, broken; finished/done for (“acabar”).

entries.zh: 破败：破败、衰败毁坏；西注“毁坏”。
entries.en: to ruin, destroy; ruined, in decay.

entries.zh: 卒：死、殁；完了、毁弃；西注“毁弃、完结、死”。
entries.en: to die, dead; finished, undone (“ruined, undone, dead”).

entries.zh: 坏：毁坏、损坏；西注“毁坏（arruinar）”。
entries.en: to ruin, spoil, break (“arruinar”).

entries.zh: 坏了：已毁坏、完蛋了；原注 acabado（完结）。
entries.en: ruined, spoiled, done for (“acabado”).

entries.zh: 坏呀：“坏呀”——表毁坏、完蛋的感叹语；西注“如感叹而言”。
entries.en: “ruined!” as an exclamation of dismay (huài-a).
